versions.guide:
Get the Elder out of the of Karansul.

The Honorable Elder will follow his liberator, but he is too weakened by his imprisonment to defend himself. Bring him to the transfer area near the city.
versions.html:
Getting the Elder out of Karansul's domain

First of all you must get the Elder out of Karansul's domain. If he dies, you should still go to the Green Clan and tell your story to the Chief.
